messages:
Dev (CEO): Thanks all for the Q&A after the all-hands. Main ask: clear next steps on partner pilot, partner revenue split, and who owns co-sell ops. Keep answers short so we can capture tasks.
Tara - VP Sales: Quick update: pipeline healthy, top funnel coming from demo -> PO improvement. Question: what revenue split do we offer partners on co-sell deals?
Liam (Partnerships): For strategic co-sell pilots we suggested a 70/30 split (us/partner) on net new ARR for the first year, plus a joint referral credit. Open to feedback.
Maya (Finance): Note: 70/30 is okay for pilots but we need to cap partner credits and include clawback language for churn within 90 days. I'll draft terms.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Who tracks partner-sourced leads vs referral? Need clear attribution so growth/KPIs are clean.
Rhea (RevOps): RevOps will own attribution rules. Request: partners add partner_id param + utm_source to signup links. We'll also have a reporting view in Looker.
Ana (PM, Product): Engineering needs to support partner attribution and a webhook for partner events. Suggested webhook payload: ```{ "event":"trial_start", "partner_id":"<id>", "email":"user@example.com", "source":"partner_x" }```
Liam (Partnerships): Partner also asked for a weekly usage webhook and SSO (SAML). We should confirm retention/security requirements before Dedicated.
Rhea (RevOps): Commission ops: co-sell deals routed through AE with partner credit flagged. Commission payouts follow our standard schedule but partner credits flow through a partner rebate ledger. I'll map this.
Tara - VP Sales: Sales ops note: AEs may approve partner discounts up to 15% on co-sell. Anything greater needs Tara + RevOps sign-off.
Maya (Finance): Billing note: if partner invoices customers, we need reseller agreement and PO terms. Otherwise we bill and send partner rebate. I'll add to draft.
Ana (PM, Product): Engineering estimate for attribution + webhook + SAML spike: 2 devs for 8 working days + 1 QA for 3 days. Tag: `partner-pilot-q2`. Any objections?
Dev (CEO): That estimate seems fine. Please prioritize minimal MVP for the pilot: attribution, trial_start webhook, and SAML handshake.
Liam (Partnerships): I'll prepare a one-page co-sell flow (lead handoff, crediting, marketing assets) and share in #partnerships by Thursday.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Growth requests UTM + partner_id on all partner landing pages and a trial funnel report. I'll coordinate with RevOps.
Rhea (RevOps): I'll create the Looker view and a dashboard tile for partner-sourced MQL -> SQL conversion. ETA: next Tuesday.
OpsBot: Reminder: "Partner Pilot Kickoff" calendar invite created for Fri 9:30 AM PT (invites sent).
Maya (Finance): I'll circulate the pilot accounting note and recommended clawback language today.
Tara - VP Sales: Action recap: 1) Eng spike for attribution + webhook + SAML (Ana + Eng). 2) Rhea to define attribution rules and commission flow. 3) Maya to draft pilot finance clauses. 4) Liam to produce co-sell 1-pager. Follow-up: Partner Pilot Kickoff Fri 9:30 AM PT.
Dev (CEO): If anyone has blockers on resources, DM me and Tara. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Ana (PM, Product): I'll create the Git ticket and include the sample webhook schema.
Liam (Partnerships): Sharing partner NDA details in DM.
Rhea (RevOps): Will post attribution rules draft in #revops by EOD.
Dev (CEO): Closing thread. Add any leftover items to the kickoff invite or the shared doc.
